info.title: Septena API
info.summary: The /v1 HTTP API of the Septena task backend.
info.description:
Generated from the route validators by backend/scripts/gen-contract.ts. Do not edit by hand.

Version v0 is unstable until Septena 1.0: fields and routes can change. The agent spec at https://septena.app/spec.md defines the records, the IDs, the claim lifecycle and every refusal code.

Agents should use the MCP server at https://api.septena.app/mcp. This API serves the apps and thin clients. Response bodies are described in words only: the server does not validate them against a schema.

Errors: a refused call answers `{ "error": "<code>", ... }`. Send `X-Septena-Errors: envelope` to get `{ "error": { "code", "message", "hint", "retryable" } }` instead, with the old fields next to it.

appSession.description: An app session access token (`sa1.…`) from a sign-in route or /v1/auth/refresh.

agentToken.description: An MCP access token (`sm2.…`) from OAuth, an agent key or an agent sign-up.

uploadToken.description: The one-use upload token from the tasks_attachment_add tool.

supportKey.name: X-Septena-Support-Key
supportKey.description: A random key the app makes once per install, for Support before sign-in.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A key you make for this write. A repeat with the same key and body in 24 hours returns the first answer with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` and writes nothing. The body field `idempotency_key` does the same.

ErrorFormat.name: X-Septena-Errors
ErrorFormat.description: `envelope`: a refused call carries the error envelope in `error`.

reason.description: On a refused task write: the refusal's code.

code.description: A refusal code. The spec lists each with its hint and retryable.

retryable.description: Whether the same request can succeed later with no action by the user.
